summary.zh: 拆分功能并行开发并划定文件归属
summary.en: Split a feature into parallel streams with file ownership

description.zh: 说明如何把一个大功能拆成独立工作流，用目录或文件归属避免多人冲突，并通过接口契约让前后端先对着约定并行开发。适合两名以上智能体同时实现同一系统的不同层，或需要决定用垂直切片还是水平分层时参考。
description.en: Shows how to split a large feature into independent streams, assign file ownership to avoid merge conflicts, and define interface contracts so parallel implementers can build against unwritten APIs. Use it for shared codebases.
